summary.text: Timm Ormsby is a Washington state representative from the 3rd District in Spokane who chairs the House Appropriations Committee. His official biography says he came to the Legislature in 2003.

paragraphs.text: Ormsby was born and raised in Spokane, according to his official biography, and is a cement mason who has belonged to the Operative Plasterers and Cement Masons International Association Local 72 since 1990.
The page says he is a past president of Local 72 and has been the business representative for the Northeastern Washington-Northern Idaho Building & Construction Trades Council since 2000.

In Olympia he chairs the House Appropriations Committee, which writes the House version of the state's biennial operating budget, and was for several years vice chair of the House Capital Budget Committee.
The page says he is a special appointee to the State Investment Board and the Select Committee on Pension Policy, which he chaired in 2013-14.
It says he is president of the Spokane Regional Labor Council and is married to Kim Ormsby, with three children and four grandchildren.
